prompt:
A pixel-crisp, full-fidelity desktop web UI design comp of a retail banking accounts page, 1440x900 desktop viewport, rendered as a flat vector screen mockup with no browser chrome, no device frame, no shadow, no perspective, no rounded outer corners — the artboard is the page itself, edge to edge.

DIRECTION: "Grouped Balance Sheet". The accounts page reads as three spacious financial groups instead of one dense institutional register. Calm, warm, generous. Enormous whitespace. Nothing is a card with a border; groups are open bands separated by air and single hairlines.

PALETTE, strictly these five: warm mineral dust canvas #EFE6DA as the page ground, pure white #FFFFFF for the statement bands, graphite #101518 for the navigation rail and primary ink, oxide orange #E4623F for exactly one action and small accent ticks, deep coordinate blue #2454D6 for balance figures only.

TYPOGRAPHY: one calm soft humanist grotesk throughout, like Hanken Grotesk — generous round bowls, open apertures, medium contrast, never condensed, never narrow, never a display serif. Sentence case for all names and headings. ALL-CAPS only for tiny 10-11px tracked micro-labels. Balance figures set in medium weight, large but not screaming, tabular lining numerals, tight and confident.

LAYOUT, left to right:
1) A narrow 200px vertical text rail on the far left with graphite #101518 ground running full page height. Inside it near the top: a small orbital-arc mark (two thin overlapping ellipses with a tiny oxide dot node) beside the wordmark "Mars Bank" in light cream, sentence case, calm humanist letterforms. Below it a simple text-only navigation list, no icons, generous 44px vertical rhythm, cream #EFE6DA type: "Overview", "Accounts" (current, marked by a single 2px oxide vertical tick on its left edge and slightly brighter white type), "Cards", "Transfer". Far bottom of rail: a tiny 10px tracked uppercase label "CLIENT" above "Cameron Vale" and "MB-7X92" in small cream type at 60 percent opacity.
2) The remaining width is the warm dust #EFE6DA canvas with very wide breathing margins, roughly 64px left padding from the rail and 72px right margin. At the top of the canvas: on the left, small 10px uppercase tracked label "YOUR ACCOUNTS" in warm muted brown-grey, and beneath it a large calm heading in graphite sentence case: "Good evening, Cameron". On the far right of that same top line, right-aligned: tiny uppercase tracked label "AVAILABLE TOTAL" in muted warm grey, and beneath it the figure "2,561,980" in deep blue #2454D6, large and confident, followed by a small graphite lowercase "model tokens" beneath it. Below the header a single 1px warm hairline rule the full content width.
3) Three stacked open white statement bands filling the rest of the canvas, each a plain #FFFFFF rectangle with square corners, no border, no drop shadow, separated by generous 28px of dust canvas showing through between them. Each band has 32px internal padding and a lot of vertical air.
   BAND ONE, header row inside the band: tiny 10px uppercase tracked oxide-brown label "SPEND" at top left with a short 16px oxide horizontal tick before it, and at the right of the band header the tiny muted label "1 account". Below it one account line: on the left "Everyday" in graphite medium humanist type at about 20px, with a small muted second line "Olympus Mons Branch · OMS-1001-0001"; on the right, right-aligned, the balance "184,220" in deep blue #2454D6 at about 34px, with a tiny muted uppercase "AVAILABLE" label above it and a small muted line beneath reading "2,180 held".
   BAND TWO, label "SAVE", right side of header "2 accounts". Two account lines separated by a faint hairline with lots of air: first "Crater Reserve", muted second line "Valles Marineris Branch · VMB-2001-0002", balance "1,840,000" in deep blue; second "Habitat Offset", muted second line "Cydonia Branch · CYD-3001-0003", balance "620,400" in deep blue with small muted "4,600 held" beneath.
   BAND THREE, label "BORROW", right side of header "1 account". One line: "Mars Bank Credit", muted second line "Olympus Mons Branch · OMS-4001-0004", and on the right the figure "82,640" in graphite #101518 rather than blue, with a tiny muted uppercase label "OWED" above it.
   At the bottom right of the canvas, aligned to the content edge, exactly one solid oxide #E4623F rectangular button, square corners, 52px tall, with white sentence-case label "Make a transfer".

CONSTRAINTS: all text must be legible, correctly spelled, and horizontally aligned on a strict grid; numerals right-aligned in a single consistent column across all three bands. No icons except the tiny orbital mark. No charts, no graphs, no sparklines, no progress bars, no avatars, no photographs, no gradients, no glow, no glass, no noise texture, no space imagery, no planets, no stars, no sci-fi HUD, no game chrome. No condensed or all-caps headlines. No borders around the bands. No extra invented marketing copy, rates, awards, percentages, or dates beyond the strings specified above. Flat, print-like, precise, calm, expensive.

References: .impeccable/mocks/banking-register-a.png (current dashboard comp) and the user's Macquarie accounts screenshot, used as visual context only.
